sentences.text: The present revisional application of the year 2019 was last heard on 23.09.2019.

The present revision of the years 2019 has been preferred praying for quashing of the impugned charge-sheet No. 03/18 dated 03.01.2018 under Sections 498A/323/307/34 of the IPC and under Sections 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act in connection with G.R. Case No. 1164/17 arising out of Sonamukhi Police Station Case No. 101/2017 dated 11.12.2017 pending in the Court of learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bishnupur at Bankura.
As none appears for the petitioner on repeated calls, the revisional application stands dismissed for default.
All connected applications, if any, stand disposed of.
Interim order, if any, stands vacated.

Let a copy of the order be sent to the learned trial court for compliance and to proceed with the trial expeditiously, if not disposed of, in accordance with law.
(Shampa Dutt (Paul), J.)
